refnamediv.refpurpose: display kill and death popup notifications on the HUD

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: cg_drawKillNotifications controls the display of kill and death popup notifications on the HUD. When enabled, a notification is shown between the crosshair and the top of the screen when you kill an opponent or are killed. The notification includes the opponent's name with HP color coding and fades out over 3 seconds. A value of 0 disables the notifications.
